title: Forest Temple (Phantom Ganon): adult Link in the boss room, boss key, 8 hearts
notes: Rush room PhantomGanonStage from coop_start_points.inc. Item and flag names appear in coop/host/src/game_items.cpp or the autotest scenarios;.
